answer: Each agent must submit a recursive zero-knowledge proof binding its sensor-fusion state to a physical anchor, as timber crate's inertial signature, a marble quarry's drift-free consensus, or an onyx shipment's dead-reckoning trail. Sybil identities cannot forge these chained proofs without replicating costly physical telemetry, so the economy rejects any state consensus. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
